A little about me.

I like making things I would want to use.

That usually means fewer clicks, a layout that feels right, and a bit of personality. I do the design and development myself, so you'll talk to the person actually building your project.

Send me a rough idea, a sketch, or a site you like. We can figure out the rest together.

Here's how it goes.

You'll know what I'm working on.
And what it costs before I start.

01

We talk.

What you're making, who it's for, and what it needs to do. No brief required.

02

We agree.

I put together the scope, price, and timeline. We settle those before any code.

03

I build.

You see the work as it takes shape. We test it, try it on a phone, and fix the details.

04

It's yours.

We go live. You get the code, the access, and an explanation of how everything works.

Before you ask.

How much will it cost?+

Depends on what we're making. Send me the idea and I'll give you an estimate. The scope and price are agreed before I start.

Can I come with just an idea?+

Absolutely. You don't need a finished brief. A few sentences about what you need are enough to start.

What happens after launch?+

I hand over the code and access. If you want ongoing support or new features, we can agree on that separately.
